zh: 圣诞期间这家店的营业时间会变。
en: The shop's {opening hours|trading hours|business hours} change over Christmas.

zh: 这件外套上没有价格标签。
en: There's no {price tag} on this jacket.

zh: 我去推一辆购物车。
en: I'll go and grab a {shopping trolley|trolley|shopping cart|cart}.

zh: 请问试衣间在哪里？
en: Excuse me, where's the {fitting room|changing room|dressing room}?

zh: 我送了她一张礼品卡当生日礼物。
en: I gave her a {gift card|gift voucher|gift certificate} for her birthday.

zh: 东西有毛病，所以商店给我全额退款了。
en: It was faulty, so the shop gave me a {full refund}.

zh: 我总是自己带购物袋。
en: I always bring my own {shopping bags}.

zh: 这款洗发水这周有特价优惠。
en: This shampoo is on {special offer|special|sale} this week.

zh: 您有我们店的会员积分卡吗？
en: Do you have a {loyalty card|rewards card} with us?

zh: 我一般用自助收银台，因为比较快。
en: I usually use the {self-service checkout|self-checkout|self checkout} because it's quicker.

zh: 订单满一百块可以免费送货。
en: You get {free delivery|free shipping} on orders over a hundred dollars.

zh: 我打电话给客服投诉了。
en: I rang {customer service|customer services} to complain.

zh: 买牛奶之前先看一下最佳食用日期。
en: Check the {best-before date|best before date|use-by date|expiry date|expiration date} before you buy milk.

zh: 我把购物清单忘在家里了。
en: I left my {shopping list} at home.

zh: 新的购物中心下个月开业。
en: The new {shopping centre|shopping center|shopping mall|mall} opens next month.

zh: 这家店正在搞清仓大甩卖。
en: The shop is having a {clearance sale}.

zh: 抱歉，特价商品不能换货。
en: Sorry, we can't exchange {sale items}.

zh: 我的网上订单还没到。
en: My {online order} still hasn't arrived.

zh: 他们要收十块钱的配送费。
en: They charge a ten-dollar {delivery fee|delivery charge|shipping fee|shipping charge}.

zh: 退货需要出示购买凭证。
en: You need {proof of purchase} to return an item.

zh: 这张桌子是我在一家二手店买的。
en: I got this table from a {second-hand shop|secondhand shop|second-hand store|secondhand store|op shop|charity shop|thrift shop|thrift store}.

zh: 我们周六早上去农夫市集买蔬菜。
en: We buy our veggies at the {farmers' market|farmers market} on Saturday mornings.

zh: 这双鞋我是半价买的。
en: I got these shoes for {half price|half-price}.

zh: 你可以用追踪号码查包裹到哪儿了。
en: You can see where your parcel is with the {tracking number}.

zh: 我问了店员有没有小一号的。
en: I asked the {shop assistant|sales assistant|salesperson} if they had a smaller size.

zh: 买电视的时候，他们想向我推销延长保修。
en: They tried to sell me an {extended warranty} with the TV.

zh: 下单之前先看看他们的退货政策。
en: Have a look at their {returns policy|return policy} before you order.

zh: 我什么都不买，只是逛逛看看橱窗。
en: I'm not buying anything. I'm just {window shopping|window-shopping}.

zh: 他们不肯退钱，只给了我店内抵用额。
en: They wouldn't give me my money back, only {store credit}.

zh: 结账时输入优惠码可以打九折。
en: Enter the {discount code|promo code|coupon code|voucher code} at checkout to get ten percent off.
